system_settings.global_system_prompt: You are an elite, avant-garde creative director for a premium cinematic stock footage agency (like Adobe Stock or Pond5). Your goal is to write prompts for a state-of-the-art AI video generator. STRICT COMPLIANCE RULES: 1. NEVER use the names of artists, real people, or fictional characters. 2. NEVER use the phrase 'in the style of'. 3. NEVER reference third-party IP, logos, trademarks, or specific branded objects (e.g., do not describe specific car models, laptops, or smartphones). 4. NEVER describe recognizable human faces. If humans are included, they MUST be completely anonymous (e.g., silhouettes, shot from behind, extreme top-down angles, or macro shots of hands only). 5. Focus entirely on photorealistic, high-end commercial concepts: macro nature, fluid dynamics, luxury abstract textures, and anonymous lifestyle B-roll. Describe the precise lighting, camera choreography, and visceral textures.

profitable_niches: Macro cinematography of bioluminescent flora and exotic photorealistic fungi
Hyper-realistic fluid dynamics and abstract 4K ink mixing in zero gravity
Anonymous cinematic silhouettes of a human figure walking in atmospheric foggy environments
Macro shots of anonymous human hands engaging in tactile crafts (pottery, woodworking) with highly detailed textures
Abstract luxury motion backgrounds featuring rippling silk, liquid gold, and moving glass
Drone-view topological landscapes of pristine, untouched natural environments (no modern architecture)
Microscopic cellular biology and organic molecular formations glowing with cinematic lighting
creative_themes: a slow build of tension releasing into explosive, colorful catharsis
sterile geometric perfection interrupted by beautiful, chaotic organic growth
melancholic isolation transforming into a warm, awe-inspiring lighting revelation
hypnotic, rhythmic repetition breaking into sudden, fluid freedom
the uncanny fusion of industrial brutalism and delicate natural flora
a stark, intimidating presence softening into an expression of profound empathy

lighting: golden hour backlighting that transitions into a bioluminescent glow
clinical fluorescent overheads suddenly shattered by harsh, rhythmic neon strobes
soft diffused overcast light pierced by a single, moving volumetric god-ray
dramatic chiaroscuro contrast with evolving, liquid-like colored gel reflections
camera: starts locked-off, then executes a rapid snap-zoom into a smooth, orbiting macro pan
seamless cinematic hyperlapse transitioning into ultra-slow-motion bullet time
fluid FPV drone dive that seamlessly morphs into a stabilized, slow-push tracking shot
extreme low-angle dutch tilt that slowly rotates into a perfect, symmetrical top-down view
action_evolution: The primary subject physically transforms, shifts state, or sheds a layer mid-shot.
The environmental physics suddenly alter, turning falling elements into anti-gravity suspension.
A secondary, unexpected element enters the frame, completely altering the lighting and mood.
The speed of the action ramps from real-time to extreme slow-motion at the climax.
imperfections: anamorphic lens flares reacting to the evolving light sources
subtle 35mm film grain and halation around high-contrast edges
dynamic depth-of-field racking focus from the extreme foreground to the background action
smudged foreground glass catching cinematic light leaks
